聚焦天津科协十大：云遥宇航李峰辉当选市科协委员
7 月 28 日，天津市科学技术协会第十次代表大会隆重开幕，会议选举产生市科协新一届领导班子——代表700余人，委员220余人，常委50余人。云遥宇航董事长李峰辉作为科技领域的代表出席会议，并成功当选为市科协委员！ 本报

7 月 28 日，天津市科学技术协会第十次代表大会隆重开幕，会议选举产生市科协新一届领导班子——代表700余人，委员220余人，常委50余人。云遥宇航董事长李峰辉作为科技领域的代表出席会议，并成功当选为市科协委员！

![](/media/news/ryjxImg19_260407110205A119.webp)

![](/media/news/ryjxImg20_260407110219A120.webp)

![](/media/news/ryjxImg21_260407110232A121.webp)
本报讯（记者 于春沣 刘国栋 胡萌伟）7月28日，天津市科学技术协会第十次代表大会开幕。市委书记陈敏尔出席并讲话。他强调，要坚持以习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想为指导，全面贯彻落实党的二十大和二十届二中、三中全会精神，深入学习贯彻习近平总书记关于科技创新的重要论述、对科协工作的重要要求和视察天津重要讲话精神，弘扬科学家精神，勇于创新、攻坚克难，以科技创新引领高质量发展、保障高水平安全，推动我市科技事业再上新水平。

中国科协党组书记、分管日常工作副主席、书记处第一书记贺军科出席并讲话。市委副书记、市长张工，市人大常委会主任喻云林，市政协主席王常松出席。市委副书记刘桂平主持。

陈敏尔代表市委、市人大常委会、市政府、市政协，向大会召开表示祝贺，向全体代表、全市广大科技工作者致以诚挚问候，对市科协第九次代表大会以来我市科技创新和科协工作取得的成绩给予肯定。他指出，党的十八大以来，习近平总书记高度重视科技创新工作，提出一系列新思想新观点新论断新要求，为做好科技工作指明了前进方向、提供了重要遵循。全市广大科技工作者要深学笃用习近平总书记关于科技创新的重要论述和对科协工作的重要要求，与习近平总书记视察天津重要讲话精神一体学习、一体贯彻，转化为深刻领悟“两个确立”的决定性意义、坚决做到“两个维护”的政治自觉、思想自觉、行动自觉。做爱党爱国的坚定践行者，胸怀“国之大者”，砥砺科技报国的初心使命，把论文写在津沽大地上，把科技成果应用在全面建设社会主义现代化大都市的火热实践中。做推进高水平科技自立自强的奋勇开拓者，挺膺担当、勇攀高峰，加强基础研究和原始创新，强化关键核心技术攻关。做发展新质生产力的先行推动者，聚焦经济社会发展需求，推进科技创新同产业创新深度融合，助力传统产业转型升级、新兴产业发展壮大、数字经济加快发展。做服务党委和政府决策的专业咨政者，围绕落实党中央决策部署、推动高质量发展“十项行动”、“三新”“三量”、“十五五”规划编制等重点工作建言献策，使相关规划、政策更有科学性、针对性、实效性。做提高全民科学素质的传播引领者，促进科研与科普有机结合，推动全社会形成讲科学、爱科学、学科学、用科学的浓厚氛围。

陈敏尔强调，全市各级科协组织要坚持党的全面领导，坚定不移走中国特色社会主义群团发展道路，不断增强政治性、先进性、群众性。着力提高服务工作水平，努力扩大基层组织有效覆盖，打造有温度、可信赖的科技工作者之家。切实加强自身建设，纵深推进全面从严治党，为推动科协事业高质量发展提供坚强保证。各级党委和政府要更加重视科技创新，关心科协干部队伍建设，支持科协组织依法依章程开展工作，主动靠前为科技工作者排忧解难、加油鼓劲，让各类人才竞相成长、各展其能、再立新功。

贺军科代表中国科协对大会召开表示热烈祝贺。他指出，党的二十大擘画了中国式现代化的宏伟蓝图，党的二十届三中全会对构建全面创新体制机制作出了系统部署，广大科技工作者迎来建功立业黄金时代，科协事业迎来改革发展宝贵机遇。天津各级科协组织要有效发挥桥梁纽带作用，担好政治责任、厚植家国情怀、汇聚创新合力，团结引领广大科技工作者听党话跟党走；要始终恪守为科技人才服务这一重要任务，深化人才培养、做好人才举荐、加强人文关怀，以科协之为助力培育创新大军；要聚焦发展新质生产力，强化科创赋能、提升科普能力、做强决策咨询、扩大开放合作，团结动员广大科技工作者在经济社会高质量发展大局中主动担当作为；要深刻把握新形势新任务，把准改革取向、坚持从严治会、提升组织效能，以全面深化改革增添事业发展新动能。

有关市领导，南开大学、天津大学负责同志，部分在津两院院士，市科协第十次代表大会代表等参加。开幕会上，市总工会代表各人民团体致贺词。会议选举产生市科协新一届领导班子。

Focus on the 10th meeting of Tianjin Association for Science and Technology: Li Fenghui from Yun Yao Aerospace has been elected as a member of the Tianjin Association for Science and Technology.
On July 28th, the 10th Congress of the Tianjin Society of Science and Technology was grandly opened. The meeting elected a new leadership team for the society - with over 700 repre

On July 28th, the 10th Congress of the Tianjin Society of Science and Technology was grandly opened. The meeting elected a new leadership team for the society - with over 700 representatives, 220 committee members, and 50 standing committee members. Li Fenghui, the chairman of Yunyao Aerospace, attended the conference as a representative from the field of science and technology and was successfully elected as a member of the Tianjin Society of Science and Technology!

![](/media/news/ryjxImg20_260407110345A123.webp)

![](/media/news/ryjxImg21_260407110402A124.webp)
According to a report (reporters: Yu Chunfeng, Liu Guodong, and Hu Mengwei), the 10th Congress of the Tianjin Municipal Association for Science and Technology opened on July 28. Chen Min’er, Secretary of the CPC Tianjin Municipal Committee, attended the opening ceremony and delivered a *ught on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era as our guiding principle; fully implement the guiding principles of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Second and Third Plenary Sessions of the 20th CPC Central Committee; thoroughly study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping’s important remarks on scientific and technological innovation, his key requirements for the work of science and technology associations, and his important speech delivered during his inspection tour of Tianjin; carry forward the spirit of scientists; dare to innovate and overcome difficulties; and leverage scientific and technological innovation to lead high-quality development and safeguard high-level security—thus elevating Tianjin’s science and technology endeavors to new heights.

He Junke, Secretary of the Party Leadership Group of the China Association for Science and Technology (CAST), Executive Vice Chairman in charge of daily operations, and First Secretary of the Secretariat, attended the event and delivered a speech. Zhang Gong, Deputy Party Secretary and Mayor of Tianjin Municipal Party Committee; Yu Yunlin, Director of the Standing Committee of the Tianjin Municipal People’s Congress; and Wang Changsong, Chairman of the Tianjin Municipal Committee of the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC), also attended. Liu Guiping, Deputy Party Secretary of the Tianjin Municipal Party Committee, presided over the event.

Chen Min’er, on behalf of the Municipal Party Committee, the Standing Committee of the Municipal People’s Congress, the Municipal Government, and the Municipal Committee of the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC), extended congratulations on the convening of the conference and conveyed sincere greetings to all delegates and to Tianjin’s broad community of science and technology workers. He commended the achievements made in scientific and technological innovation and in the work of the Tianjin Association for Science and Technology (TAST) since its Ninth Congress.  

He pointed out that since the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China (CPC)*tance to scientific and technological innovation, putting forward a series of new ideas, viewpoints, judgments, and requirements, thus charting the course and providing fundamental guidance for advancing science and technology work. All science and technology workers across the city must thoroughly study and earnestly apply General Secretary Xi Jinping’s important discourses on scientific and technological innovation and his key instructions regarding the work of associations for science and technology, integrating these with the spirit of his important speech delivered during his inspection tour of Tianjin—studying them as one body and implementing them as one body—so as to translate this understanding into political, ideological, and practical consciousness of profoundly comprehending the decisive significance of the “Two Establishments” and resolutely upholding the “Two Upholds.”  

— Be steadfast practitioners devoted to the Party and the country: bear in mind the “fundamental interests of the state,” uphold the original aspiration and mission of serving the nation through science and technology, publish scholarly work grounded in Tianjin’s soil, and apply scientific and technological achievements to the vibrant practice of building Tianjin into a modern socialist metropolis in all respects.  
— Be courageous pioneers advancing high-level self-reliance and strength in science and technology: shoulder responsibilities with resolve and strive unceasingly for excellence; intensify basic research and original innovation; strengthen efforts to overcome bottlenecks in core technologies critical to national development.  
— Be vanguard promoters fostering new quality productive forces: focus on socioeconomic development needs; deepen the integrated advancement of scientific and technological innovation and industrial innovation; support the transformation and upgrading of traditional industries, the growth and expansion of emerging industries, and the accelerated development of the digital economy.  
— Be professional policy advisors serving Party committees and governments: provide advice and proposals on key tasks such as implementing the CPC Central Committee’s decisions and deployments, advancing the “Ten Initiatives” for high-quality development, promoting the “Three News” (“new quality, new pattern, new momentum”) and “Three Quantities” (“quantity, quality, and efficiency”), and formulating the 15th Five-Year Plan, thereby enhancing the scientific rigor, relevance, and effectiveness of related plans and policies.  
— Be communicators and leaders in raising public scientific literacy: promote the organic integration of scientific research and science popularization; foster throughout society a strong atmosphere of valuing, loving, studying, and applying science.

Chen Min’er emphasized that science and technology associations at all levels across the city must uphold the Party’s overall leadership, unswervingly follow the path of mass organization development with Chinese characteristics under socialism, and continuously strengthen their political nature, advanced nature, and mass orientation. They must focus on improving service capabilities, expand effective coverage of grassroots organizations, and build a warm, trustworthy “home for science and technology workers.” They must also strengthen their own capacity building, deepen full and rigorous governance over the Party, and provide a strong guarantee for high-quality development of the science and technology association cause. Party committees and governments at all levels must attach greater importance to scientific and technological innovation, care about the development of science and technology association cadres, support science and technology associations in carrying out work in accordance with laws and their charters, proactively step forward to resolve difficulties and boost morale for science and technology workers, and enable all types of talent to grow vigorously, fully demonstrate their abilities, and achieve new accomplishments.

He Junke, on behalf of the China Association for Science and Technology (CAST), extended warm congratulations on the convening of the conference. He pointed out that the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China (CPC) has laid out a grand blueprint for Chinese-style modernization, and the Third Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee has systematically deployed the establishment of a comprehensive innovation system and mechanism. This marks a golden era for scientists and engineers to achieve remarkable accomplishments and presents a valuable opportunity for CAST’s reform and development. Local CAST organizations in Tianjin must effectively serve as bridges and bonds, shouldering political responsibilities, cultivating deep patriotism and devotion to the nation, and pooling innovative synergies to unite and lead scientists and engineers in following the Party’s leadership wholeheartedly. They must consistently uphold service to scientific and technological professionals as a core mission—deepening talent cultivation, actively recommending outstanding talents, and strengthening humanistic care—to contribute, through CAST’s proactive efforts, to nurturing a large contingent of innovative talents. They must focus on fostering new-quality productive forces by strengthening science-and-technology innovation support, enhancing science popularization capacity, bolstering policy advisory capabilities, and expanding openness and cooperation—thus uniting and mobilizing scientists and engineers to proactively assume responsibility and make contributions to the overall high-quality economic and social development. They must deeply grasp the new situation and new tasks, accurately align reform orientation, adhere to strict governance of CAST, and enhance organizational effectiveness—injecting fresh impetus into CAST’s development through comprehensive, deep-going reforms.

Attendees included municipal leaders, responsible officials from Nankai University and Tianjin University, some academicians of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and Chinese Academy of Engineering based in Tianjin, and delegates to the Tenth Municipal Congress of the Tianjin Association for Science and Technology (TJAST). At the opening ceremony, the Tianjin Federation of Trade Unions delivered a congratulatory speech on behalf of all people’s organizations. The congress elected a new leadership team for the TJAST.
